original_source_units: 11 public camera ID x 3 author-publication-derived clock label bins; 184 Water deer and 273 Wild boar photographed event counts

null.object: Conditional random allocation of each camera's published species counts across its fixed three combined species clock-period totals
null.assigned_worlds: Each possible Water-deer 3-bin allocation w_s,z has count weight product_z choose(t_s,z,w_s,z); all 11 camera allocations combine independently under the formal null
null.global_denominator: product of each site's local denominator
null.observed_original_v3_statistic: D=O(camera_only)−O(camera×clock), with O=sum cells min(record fraction water,record fraction boar); site-only overlap is fixed under null
null.one_sided_direction: Greater conditional detected-time dissimilarity D means S <= observed original table score
null.expected_value: Exact sum of local integer-score expectations, NOT Monte Carlo
null.probability_calculation: Exact DP convolution of integer-weighted camera score pmfs; P_null(S<=S_observed) as a ratio of integers
null.central_interval: Exact distribution 2.5 and 97.5 percent quantiles for D using inverse-CDF
null.one_site_diagnostic: Post-outcome source camera G19, one-sided observed extra-gap probability within only that camera; NOT a confirmatory site test

interpretation_ceiling: FORMAL_FINITE_RECORD_LABEL_EXCHANGEABILITY_NULL_ONLY; does not reject time-within-camera equality nor claim ecological animal-population mechanism
